## anime_ccd_candid

> 复古 CCD 相机风格自拍 / Vintage CCD camera-style candid (a non-photoreal staged "authenticity").

**Artifact:** `photo`, `1088x1920`, aspect `9:16`
**Demo vars:** `templates/anime/_vars_examples/ccd_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical mobile-phone-format candid snapshot of a subject described as "a young friend in a cropped puffer jacket holding a hot can of coffee, half-laughing at the camera", staged to look as if captured on an early-2000s consumer CCD compact camera. The frame catches the subject mid-moment, off-center, slightly cropped at the edge as if the photographer didn't quite line up the shot.
[2. Action] The subject is doing something ordinary and unposed — laughing mid-sentence, glancing sideways, blinking, brushing hair away — captured the instant a casual phone-pic might land. No fashion pose, no eye-contact runway gaze, no studio choreography.
[3. Scene] The setting is "outside a 24-hour convenience store on a quiet residential street" at 01:42 AM · 2026.04.27. Ambient light is realistic and ordinary: dim interior, late-night street, or grey afternoon room. Whatever surrounds the subject reads as real life rather than a constructed set.
[4. Composition] Vertical 9:16 frame, off-center subject placement, slight tilt of a few degrees, edge-of-frame cropping that feels accidentally composed. A subtle motion blur ghosts a hand or hair edge. The horizon, if visible, is not perfectly level. Very minimal overlaid element: a tiny date-stamp style timestamp burned into one corner.
[5. Style] Vintage CCD compact-camera aesthetic — harsh on-camera flash with visible falloff darkening the corners, fine sensor / film grain, a slight off-color cast (cool magenta in shadow, warm yellow in highlight), modest red-eye when the flash hits a face in low light, soft chromatic fringing at high-contrast edges. Mood is "warm, sleepy, half-tipsy after a long evening". The image must feel grainy and imperfect, not AI-glossy. Definitely not editorial fashion.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- timestamp_overlay: "01:42 AM · 2026.04.27"

NO: studio-perfect lighting, professional model pose, AI-glossy plastic skin, heavy beauty retouching, editorial fashion staging, clean noise-free render, perfect rule-of-thirds composition, centered eye-contact gaze, real-celebrity likeness, branded copyrighted IP, watermarks beyond the corner timestamp, lens flare, HDR oversaturation
```

## anime_character_sheet

> Concept-art character reference sheet with three-view turnaround, expression sheet, and prop detail.

**Artifact:** `character_sheet`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/anime/_vars_examples/character_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A clean concept-art reference sheet for an anime/manga character named Mira Holloway, archetype "wandering star-chart navigator", from the world of an airship-trade-route fantasy archipelago. The sheet contains a three-view full-body turnaround (front, side, back), a row of four expression headshots, a detail inset for brass sextant on a leather lanyard, and a small palette swatch strip with a caption.
[2. Action] All figures stand at rest in neutral T-pose-adjacent stances; the expression heads display four distinct emotional beats; the prop sits inert in its detail box. Nothing is mid-action. The sheet reads as a static reference an artist would pin to a wall.
[3. Scene] Pure white reference-sheet ground (#FFFFFF). No environment, no cast shadows beyond a subtle ground contact tone under each figure. Faint horizontal pencil rules optionally visible at very low contrast to indicate scale.
[4. Composition] 16:9 frame. Top row (~58% of vertical space) holds the three-view turnaround with figures evenly spaced left-to-right and labeled "Front", "Side", "Back" beneath. Bottom row (~32%) is split into two zones: left two-thirds carries four expression headshots in a horizontal strip under the header "Expressions"; right one-third holds the prop detail with caption "Detail: brass sextant on a leather lanyard" and beneath it a thin horizontal palette swatch strip with the caption Indigo · Brass · Ivory · Slate. The character name banner sits across the very top in a slim header band.
[5. Style] Clean concept-art reference aesthetic — confident anime/manga line art with subtle cel-shading at two tonal stops, soft pencil construction lines visible at very low opacity, ink-and-pencil feel. Signature features asymmetric side-shaved silver hair and long indigo navigator coat with brass shoulder clasps must read clearly across all three views. Color palette is moderate, no neon. Typography for labels is a slim industrial sans-serif.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):

- label_front: "Front"
- label_side: "Side"
- label_back: "Back"
- header_expr: "Expressions"
- prop_caption: "Detail: brass sextant on a leather lanyard"
- palette_caption: "Indigo · Brass · Ivory · Slate"

- signature accessory or weapon

NO: photorealistic skin, busy environment background, dynamic action pose, lens flare, watermarks, real-celebrity likeness, branded copyrighted IP, rainbow neon palette, 3D rendered look, cluttered floating ornaments
```

## anime_city_poster

> 双语城市旅行海报 / Bilingual editorial city travel poster mixing calligraphic skyline and premium typography.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1088x1920`, aspect `9:16`
**Demo vars:** `templates/anime/_vars_examples/city_poster_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical editorial travel poster celebrating the city of Tokyo during Spring 2026. The lower third of the poster holds a stylized panoramic silhouette built from three signature landmarks — Tokyo Tower, Senso-ji's main hall, and the Rainbow Bridge — flowing together as a single horizon line. The upper two-thirds reserves negative space for a large city wordmark and bilingual taglines.
[2. Action] The poster sits as a still editorial print. The viewer first reads the oversized city name, scans the bilingual tagline pair, then follows the calligraphic curve of the skyline across the bottom. No motion, no parallax, no depicted human figures.
[3. Scene] Off-white textured paper background reminiscent of premium magazine stock, with subtle warm cream undertones and very faint paper grain. A single ink color (deep ink blue or charcoal) carries the line work; one warm accent (sunrise gold or coral) marks the season tag and a small stamp seal at the bottom corner.
[4. Composition] Vertical 9:16 frame. Top ~10% margin. Title zone (~22%) holds the city wordmark large and tight-tracked, set bilingual: a primary serif rendering and a secondary sans-serif rendering stacked. Mid zone (~40%) is mostly blank paper holding only the season-and-year badge and the two taglines (zh-CN above, en below) integrated into the negative space. Lower zone (~28%) carries the calligraphic landmark curve transforming the three landmarks into a single continuous skyline. Bottom margin (~6%) holds a small accent stamp. Generous outer margins.
[5. Style] Editorial premium travel poster aesthetic — Monocle / Kinfolk / Tokyo metro poster sensibility. Mix of a calligraphic display serif (for the city name) with a contemporary geometric sans (for the bilingual taglines and the season badge). Hand-drawn ink line for the skyline, dreamlike scale shifts where landmarks lean into one another. Restrained palette: paper, ink, single warm accent. No photographic elements, no neon, no 3D.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- city_name: "Tokyo"
- season_badge: "Spring 2026"
- tagline_zh: "在霓虹与樱花之间，慢慢走"
- tagline_en: "Walk slowly, between neon and cherry blossom."

NO: photographic skyline, neon city lights, 3D rendered buildings, real-celebrity likeness, branded corporate logos, lens flare, heavy gradient washes, watermarks, rainbow palette, busy stock-photo collage
```

## anime_comic_8panel

> Eight-panel sequential manga page rendered in black-and-white seinen ink with strict character continuity.

**Artifact:** `comic_page`, `1024x1536`, aspect `2:3`
**Demo vars:** `templates/anime/_vars_examples/comic_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A black-and-white manga page starring the protagonist Hayato, described as "lanky junior programmer, messy bedhead, oversized hoodie", set in a cramped Tokyo studio apartment lit only by a single desk lamp. The page contains exactly eight sequential panels that read right-to-left, top-to-bottom, telling a single short beat per panel. Beat 1 establishes context, beats 2–7 escalate, beat 8 lands the punch.
[2. Action] Across the eight panels the action progresses as follows: panel 1 — alarm clock reads 3:00; Hayato stares wide-eyed at his terminal; panel 2 — build fails with a wall of red errors; he clutches his hair; panel 3 — close-up on a single missing semicolon highlighted on screen; panel 4 — Hayato leaps up triumphantly, fist raised; panel 5 — he hits Run; the progress bar crawls; sweat beads on his brow; panel 6 — tests pass green; he collapses backward into his chair; panel 7 — wide shot — sunrise creeps through the blinds, his cat yawns; panel 8 — Hayato face-down on the desk, asleep; a deploy notification pings. The protagonist's appearance, hairstyle, and outfit silhouette must remain recognizable in every panel.
[3. Scene] The page lives inside the world of a cramped Tokyo studio apartment lit only by a single desk lamp. Backgrounds appear as rendered linework rather than full painted scenery, supporting each panel's beat without overpowering the figures. Screen-tone shading provides atmosphere; no full grey washes.
[4. Composition] Vertical 2:3 page divided into a dynamic 8-panel grid. Suggested layout: row 1 holds two equal panels; row 2 holds three smaller panels of varied width; row 3 holds a single wide panoramic panel plus a tall vertical strip; row 4 holds one final wide panel delivering the punch. Gutters are 12px wide with crisp ink borders. Each panel uses a distinct camera angle (close-up, over-shoulder, low angle, wide establishing) to vary rhythm.
[5. Style] Black-and-white seinen-style manga ink. Confident inked outlines, selective hatch shading, screen-tone fills for fabric and backgrounds, deep solid blacks for shadow accents. No color, no soft watercolor, no painterly texture. Typography for panel captions is a thin handwritten sans, restrained, English Latin only.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- page_title: "Hayato"
- tagline: "Ship it. Sleep later."

Preserve (edit mode only):
- protagonist hairstyle
- signature accessory
- outfit silhouette
- facial proportions across panels

NO: color rendering, full-color illustration, photographic background, 3D model render, lens flare, watermarks, branded copyrighted manga IP, real-celebrity likeness, chibi super-deformed proportions, inconsistent character design between panels
```
